Class ElementCatalog

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.ElementCatalog
public final class ElementCatalog extends Object
Built-in element and isotope data, including names, atomic numbers, and electron shell counts.

      public static List<ElementCatalog.Element> elements()
      Returns all bundled reference elements in atomic-number order, from hydrogen through oganesson.

      Returns all host-defined extension elements registered at runtime.

    • register

      public static void register(ElementCatalog.Element element, Map<String,String> facts)
      Registers host-defined elements without replacing the bundled 118-element reference.
      Parameters:
      element - the element definition to register
      facts - a map of supplementary fact strings for the element
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the atomic number or symbol is invalid or already registered

    • bySymbol

      public static ElementCatalog.Element bySymbol(String symbol)
      Returns an element by its symbol. Symbols are case-sensitive, as in molecule definitions.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the element symbol (e.g., "H", "Fe")
      Returns:
      the corresponding ElementCatalog.Element
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the symbol is unknown

    • byAtomicNumber

      public static ElementCatalog.Element byAtomicNumber(int atomicNumber)
      Returns an element by its atomic number.
      Parameters:
      atomicNumber - the atomic number
      Returns:
      the corresponding ElementCatalog.Element
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the atomic number is unknown

    • fact

      public static String fact(String symbol, String key)
      Returns a specific fact string for an element symbol.

      Missing facts remain empty so cards can also show host-authored synthetic elements.

      Parameters:
      symbol - the element symbol
      key - the fact key
      Returns:
      the fact string, or an empty string if not found

    • color

      public static int color(String symbol)
      Returns the theme color associated with an element symbol, using a default fallback color.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the element symbol
      Returns:
      the ARGB color integer

    • color

      public static int color(String symbol, int fallback)
      Returns the theme color associated with an element symbol, specifying a custom fallback color.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the element symbol
      fallback - the fallback ARGB color if the element is unknown
      Returns:
      the ARGB color integer

    • configuration

      public static AtomicConfiguration configuration(String symbol, int massNumber)
      Creates an atomic configuration for a neutral atom of a listed isotope.

      Mass number is not inferred from atomic weight.

      Parameters:
      symbol - the element symbol
      massNumber - the specific isotope mass number
      Returns:
      the corresponding AtomicConfiguration
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the isotope is not present in the catalog
